AJ, saw PlanSource named UKG's 2025 Innovator of the Year and launch the SAVVI Financial partnership.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PlanSource off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

AJ, quick follow-up for PlanSource.

As new recognition and partnerships drive demand, the pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most sellers cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PlanSource needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

AJ, last bit of proof for PlanSource.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PlanSource's reply rate likely compares to other benefits-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
